body:
## What's Changed
* Run the sampler without sudo; wait-channel states, sustained CPU alerts, alert settings in the dashboard by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/1
* docs: add architecture diagrams for sampler, collector and dashboard by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/2
* C++ collector as the default (Python as backup), comparison and test results by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/3
* Add C++ coding standards adapted from modern_exchng_cpp by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/5
* Retire the Python collector; keep its alerting code in alerting/ by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/6
* Move shared wire format and FileDescriptor into common/ by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/7
* Build the collector with GCC 13: embed the dashboard page without #embed by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/9
* Tests: wait for the sleep target to be asleep before sampling it by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/10
* Use std::expected instead of exceptions in the collector and sampler by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/8
* Add socket I/O and processed-message metrics with dashboard views by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/4
* Build a process overview dashboard and restart command by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/12
* Add the MIT license by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/14
* Add runtime sampler controls and socket observation wrapper by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/11
* Control the local sampler target from the dashboard by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/15
* Monitor pressure, limits, memory and socket buffers for the target by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/17
* Reduce deployment dependencies and add static release builds by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/16
* docs: require worktrees, descriptive branches, and prompt PRs by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/18
* Use ASD-STE100 for agent communication by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/19
* Fix collector failure with older resource databases by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/20
* Add historical process and thread inspection with durable snapshots by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/13
* Add a visual README: logo, animated architecture, performance charts by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/22
* Animate the README: five new animations, shorter text by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/23
* Sampler: remove heap allocations after startup (TigerStyle) by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/21
* Collector: remove heap allocations from the datagram path by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/24
* Wire: send datagrams as structs, without field-by-field encoding by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/25
* docs: add animated collector and sampler READMEs by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/28
* Make the build easy on other systems and test it in AlmaLinux by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/26
* docs: reduce project agent instructions by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/30
* Design: process memory map dashboard tab by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/32
* docs: design delayed contextual help for the dashboard by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/33
* Reduce duplicate agent guidance by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/31
* Add AlmaLinux build guidelines and enforce complete checks by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/27
* Simplify C++ coding standards by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/36
* Sample the memory map in the sampler loop (simpler alternative to #34) by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/37
* Add quiet contextual help to the dashboard by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/35
* Redesign the memory-map dashboard section after the mock-up by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/39
* Use space below Zoom for memory limits by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/40
* Add dashboard section separators by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/41
* Keep runtime files under ~/triangulator without root access by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/42
* docs: refresh README feature tour and screenshots by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/44
* Publish AlmaLinux 8 and 9 release packages by @breakbadsp in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/43

## New Contributors
* @breakbadsp made their first contribution in https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/commits/v0.1.0
